searchText: Is they're anything we can do to help support you or provide assistance? <@!259648573401071617> <@!425279588009246720> I am late to the part of reviewing your EIP, only reading it today and I have spotted something the mapping `[accountAddress -> codeRoot]` is not static because of CREATE2 capabilities. And I think I have seen the contract code changing on mainnet 🙂 I have not finished reading yet though, will let you know if I find something else That’s correct, but if I understand correctly, it is still not possible to overwrite existing code (see https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-689-address-collision-of-contract-address-causes-exceptional-halt/3542/3). If an account is self-destructed, code can be placed again via create2. However that section in the merkleization doc says that upon selfdestruct code is removed, and thus allows for reinsertion via create2, i.e. it can work correctly. Whenever I find the time I really want to sort out that missing clarification linked above, there are numerous issues on the EIP repo regarding to it.
